observation_summary: An attempt to serialize a POJO containing binary data from an InputStream results in a JsonMappingException stating that the operation is not supported.
reasoning_summary: The bug report and stack traces indicate that the 'ToXmlGenerator' class fails when attempting to serialize binary data provided as an 'InputStream'. The stack trace shows a 'JsonMappingException' with the message 'Operation not supported by generator of type com.fasterxml.jackson.dataformat.xml.ser.ToXmlGenerator', which occurs because the generator lacks an implementation for the 'writeBinary(Base64Variant, InputStream, int)' method. This is a classic case of a missing feature in an interface implementation, where the generator only supports byte arrays but not streaming binary data.
